🔹 VRP SIGNAL, only sell when implied exceeds realized
🔹 DAILY REHEDGE, keep delta neutral against the underlying
🔹 WINGS REQUIRED, far OTM puts cap catastrophic loss
🔹 GAMMA RISK, short gamma loses on extremes, weekly rehedging contains it

Feb 2018. March 2020. Both wiped out unhedged premium sellers. The strategy isn't the short straddle. The strategy is the hedge around it.
